medicalRecords.symptoms: Mild racing heart rate following intense jogging, no chest tightness or syncope.
medicalRecords.clinicalNotes: Resting ECG shows regular sinus rhythm (74 bpm). Blood pressure is within normal parameters (118/76 mmHg). Cardiac auscultation normal S1/S2, no murmurs heard. Symptoms likely exacerbated by caffeine intake and dehydration prior to workouts.
medicalRecords.treatmentPlan: Advised hydration (minimum 2.5L/day), moderation of pre-workout caffeine stimulants. Recommended gentle warm-up cooldown routines. Holter monitoring if symptoms escalate.

medicalRecords.symptoms: Erythematous pruritic patches on bilateral dorsal hands and interdigital folds.
medicalRecords.clinicalNotes: Skin inspection reveals mild scaling, erythema, and excoriation on dorsal hands. No signs of secondary bacterial impetiginization. Patient notes frequent alcohol-based hand sanitization at office.
medicalRecords.treatmentPlan: Apply topical corticosteroid ointment twice daily for 7 days. Switch to gentle soap-free cleanser. Barrier repair ceramide cream 3-4 times daily.
